description: Ratchet on write routes that touch the ledger or stock ledger. uncoveredSensitiveCeiling is held at zero by the unauthenticated guard sweep. guardOnlySensitiveCeiling is also held at zero: a sensitive write may not be protected only by that anonymous-auth check. Deep route tests provide exact positive-path accounting/stock assertions, while tests/write-route-authenticated-safety-sweep.test.ts dynamically exercises any route that would otherwise be guard-only as an authenticated privileged user and asserts atomic failure/no partial mutation, balanced vouchers, and cross-company isolation sentinels.
